$comment: Every reference A and reference B browser capability (tests/browser-parity/reference) mapped to its cmux equivalent and the scenario:key that proves it, or to an exclusion from docs/browser-repl/README.md. unit/capabilities.test.mjs keeps this complete.

tap.cmux: locator.tap() (a click: panes have no touch screen)

Browsers.get.cmux: not needed: the session drives its workspace's browser; tabs

Browsers.getDefault.cmux: not needed: the session drives its workspace's browser; tabs

Browsers.getForUrl.cmux: not needed: the session drives its workspace's browser; tabs.open(url)

Browsers.list.cmux: not needed: one browser per workspace; tabs.list()

Browser.capabilities.excluded: Raw CDP: WebKit has no DevTools protocol, so there is no page.cdp; reference B also withholds it by default (case browser.capabilities records both lacking it). Its viewport capability is page.setViewportSize().

Browser.user.cmux: tabs.list() lists every workspace tab; tabs.use(id) attaches one

Browser.history.cmux: tabs.history({ query, from, to, limit }): cmux browser history, most recent first, as { url, title, dateVisited }

BrowserUser.claimTab.cmux: tabs.use(id) attaches a user's tab of the session's own workspace; a user's tab of another workspace needs a person's grant, which cmux does not offer yet, so it is refused

BrowserUser.getTabContext.cmux: snapshot(await tabs.get(id)) reads a tab without switching to it

Tabs.content.cmux: tabs.content({ urls, format: text|markdown|html|snapshot }) loads each URL in a background tab, extracts it and closes the tab

Tab.capabilities.cmux: page.setViewportSize(), page.viewportSize() (the viewport capability); raw CDP is excluded (Browser.capabilities)

Tab.markHandoff.cmux: page.keep(); a later call attaches it with tabs.use(id)

Tab.requestManualHandoff.cmux: page.bringToFront(): panes are local, so the user can take over any tab

AXAPI.scroll.cmux: page.mouse.wheel(dx, dy) over a [scrollable] ref, locator.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()

ContentAPI.export.cmux: page.exportContent() writes the page as Markdown and returns the file path

ContentAPI.exportGsuite.cmux: page.exportContent({ format: pdf|md|docx|xlsx|csv|pptx|... }) on a Google Docs, Sheets or Slides tab

ContentAPI.exportYouTubeTranscript.cmux: page.exportContent({ transcript: true }) on a YouTube watch page

DomCUAAPI.scroll.cmux: page.mouse.wheel(dx, dy) over a ref's box

BeforeUnloadDialog.type.cmux: page.dialog().type is "beforeunload" when WebKit raises the prompt; navigations the agent starts leave without one, as reference B's Chrome accepts it itself
BeforeUnloadDialog.type.note: Same held-dialog path as the other types. Playwright's headless WebKit (the dev driver) never fires beforeunload, so this type is unproven outside the app.

BeforeUnloadDialog.dismiss.note: Same held-dialog path as the other types; beforeunload itself is unproven in the dev driver.

sites.$comment: Site integrations: every reference A site global and method (reference A CLI 1.26.916 skills and REPL globals) and every reference B site capability, mapped to the cmux sites.*/tabs.* equivalent with proving tests (sites/<file>: <test title prefix> in tests/browser-parity/sites, or diff:<case id>), or to a pending user decision with its reason (docs/browser-repl/site-tools.md, Decisions). reference/site-surface.txt lists the members; unit/capabilities.test.mjs fails on an unmapped one.

googlePeople.reason: Google Contacts lookup reads the user's address book; cmux has no contacts tool yet and whether agents may read contacts is the user's call. Gmail search (sites.gmail.search("from:name")) finds addresses in mail.

imageSearch.reason: Image search and generation are not browser operations; image generation needs an API credential (docs/browser-repl/site-tools.md, decision 4).

imagegen.reason: Image generation is not a browser operation and needs an API credential; reference A's imagegen printed OAuth tokens in a probe (docs/browser-repl/site-tools.md, decision 4).

imessage.reason: iMessage, SMS and KakaoTalk read local message databases and send as the user; they are not browser operations (docs/browser-repl/site-tools.md, decision 3).

captcha.reason: Solving CAPTCHAs defeats a site's check that a person is present; cmux reports the captcha code and stops (docs/browser-repl/site-tools.md, decision 1).

applePasswords.reason: Reading or autofilling a password manager puts vault access behind an agent; sites.browserAuth covers sign-in without it (docs/browser-repl/site-tools.md, decision 2).

passwordManager.reason: Reading or autofilling a password manager puts vault access behind an agent; sites.browserAuth covers sign-in without it (docs/browser-repl/site-tools.md, decision 2).

cua.cmux: page.mouse, page.keyboard (native input in the page); desktop control outside the browser is not the REPL's job

chrome.cmux: tabs.history (history), tabs.list({ all: true }) (open tabs), download events (downloads); Chrome bookmarks, top sites and tab groups have no WebKit counterpart

installPageScript.cmux: page.addScriptTag({ content }) or page.evaluate(fn) in the current document

referenceA.sessions.cmux: named REPL sessions (cmux browser repl --session NAME, reset)
